import Base
import Tasks.Intersection

namespace Submission
theorem solve : Tasks.intersection :=
by
  intro G H J g h j f q hf hq
  have hom_one : ∀ {A B : Type} (a : Foundation.Group A)
      (b : Foundation.Group B) (r : A → B)
      (hr : ∀ x y, r (a.mul x y) = b.mul (r x) (r y)),
      r a.one = b.one := by
    intro A B a b r hr
    have hidem : b.mul (r a.one) (r a.one) = r a.one := by
      rw [← hr, a.one_mul]
    calc
      r a.one = b.mul b.one (r a.one) := (b.one_mul _).symm
      _ = b.mul (b.mul (b.inv (r a.one)) (r a.one)) (r a.one) := by
        rw [b.inv_mul]
      _ = b.mul (b.inv (r a.one)) (b.mul (r a.one) (r a.one)) :=
        b.mul_assoc _ _ _
      _ = b.mul (b.inv (r a.one)) (r a.one) := by rw [hidem]
      _ = b.one := b.inv_mul _
  have inv_closed : ∀ {A B : Type} (a : Foundation.Group A)
      (b : Foundation.Group B) (r : A → B)
      (hr : ∀ x y, r (a.mul x y) = b.mul (r x) (r y))
      (x : A), r x = b.one → r (a.inv x) = b.one := by
    intro A B a b r hr x hx
    calc
      r (a.inv x) = b.mul (r (a.inv x)) b.one := (b.mul_one _).symm
      _ = b.mul (r (a.inv x)) (r x) := by rw [hx]
      _ = r (a.mul (a.inv x) x) := (hr _ _).symm
      _ = r a.one := by rw [a.inv_mul]
      _ = b.one := hom_one a b r hr
  refine ⟨{
    one := ⟨g.one, hom_one g h f hf, hom_one g j q hq⟩
    mul := fun x y => ⟨g.mul x.val y.val,
      by rw [hf, x.property.1, y.property.1, h.one_mul],
      by rw [hq, x.property.2, y.property.2, j.one_mul]⟩
    inv := fun x => ⟨g.inv x.val,
      inv_closed g h f hf x.val x.property.1,
      inv_closed g j q hq x.val x.property.2⟩
    one_mul := by
      intro x
      apply Subtype.eq
      exact g.one_mul x.val
    mul_one := by
      intro x
      apply Subtype.eq
      exact g.mul_one x.val
    mul_assoc := by
      intro x y z
      apply Subtype.eq
      exact g.mul_assoc x.val y.val z.val
    inv_mul := by
      intro x
      apply Subtype.eq
      exact g.inv_mul x.val
  }, ?_⟩
  exact ⟨rfl, (fun _ _ => rfl), (fun _ => rfl)⟩

end Submission

  have inv_closed : ∀ {A B : Type} (a : Foundation.Group A)
      (b : Foundation.Group B) (r : A → B)
      (hr : ∀ x y, r (a.mul x y) = b.mul (r x) (r y))
      (x : A), r x = b.one → r (a.inv x) = b.one := by
    intro A B a b r hr x hx

      r (a.inv x) = b.mul (r (a.inv x)) b.one := (b.mul_one _).symm
      _ = b.mul (r (a.inv x)) (r x) := by rw [hx]
      _ = r (a.mul (a.inv x) x) := (hr _ _).symm
      _ = r a.one := by rw [a.inv_mul]

import Base
import Tasks.KernelGroup

namespace Submission
theorem solve : Tasks.kernelGroup :=
by
  intro G H g h f hf
  have cancel (a b c : H) (he : h.mul a b = h.mul a c) : b = c := by
    have hi := congrArg (fun z => h.mul (h.inv a) z) he
    simpa only [← h.mul_assoc, h.inv_mul, h.one_mul] using hi
  have hone : f g.one = h.one := by
    apply cancel (f g.one)
    calc
      h.mul (f g.one) (f g.one) = f (g.mul g.one g.one) := (hf _ _).symm
      _ = f g.one := congrArg f (g.one_mul g.one)
      _ = h.mul (f g.one) h.one := (h.mul_one _).symm
  have hinv (x : G) (hx : f x = h.one) : f (g.inv x) = h.one := by
    calc
      f (g.inv x) = h.mul (f (g.inv x)) h.one := (h.mul_one _).symm
      _ = h.mul (f (g.inv x)) (f x) := congrArg (fun z => h.mul (f (g.inv x)) z) hx.symm
      _ = f (g.mul (g.inv x) x) := (hf _ _).symm
      _ = f g.one := congrArg f (g.inv_mul x)
      _ = h.one := hone
  let kone : {x : G // f x = h.one} := ⟨g.one, hone⟩
  let kmul : {x : G // f x = h.one} → {x : G // f x = h.one} →
      {x : G // f x = h.one} := fun x y =>
    ⟨g.mul x.val y.val, by rw [hf, x.property, y.property, h.one_mul]⟩
  let kinv : {x : G // f x = h.one} → {x : G // f x = h.one} :=
    fun x => ⟨g.inv x.val, hinv x.val x.property⟩
  let k : Foundation.Group {x : G // f x = h.one} := {
    one := kone
    mul := kmul
    inv := kinv
    one_mul := by
      intro x
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact g.one_mul x.val
    mul_one := by
      intro x
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact g.mul_one x.val
    mul_assoc := by
      intro x y z
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact g.mul_assoc x.val y.val z.val
    inv_mul := by
      intro x
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact g.inv_mul x.val
  }
  exact ⟨k, rfl, (by intro x y; rfl), (by intro x; rfl)⟩

end Submission
